title: Metrics of an invalidated or replaced Soundcharts identity stay published
evidence: lib/integrations/sync.ts (base): unresolved/not_configured branches clear the UUID but leave artist_metrics/integration_metric_cache
tests/integration/soundcharts-identity-sync.mjs fails on base: 'metrics of an invalidated identity must not stay published'
rootCause: Identity lifecycle and metric lifecycle were not coupled: invalidation updated only the identity row; upserts only overwrote platforms returned by the new identity.
affectedFlow: artist links → identity → metrics → public pages
invariantViolated: Metrics belong to the identity that produced them (ZERO≠NULL≠STALE≠WRONG IDENTITY)
blastRadius: public follower/listener numbers of the wrong or unverified artist after link edits

autofix.reason: root cause proven by DB-backed test; purge is scoped to source='soundcharts' of that entity

correction: purge entity soundcharts metrics atomically when identity is cleared or its UUID changes; keep values on same-identity outages
regressionRisk: low — same-identity outage path covered by test

history.note: root cause traceable in repo; autofix eligible
identity invalidation did not withdraw metrics
re-running the detecting check on the fixed code
